Ingredients: DONUT YEAST GLAZED 2.5 OZ FZ (PLAIN DONUT: ENRICHED WHEAT FLOUR, WATER, SUGAR, VEGETABLE OIL [PALM OIL SHORTENING, CANOLA AND/OR SOYBEAN OIL], SOY FLOUR, CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF: SKIM MILK POWDER, SODIUM ACID PYROPHOSPHATE, DEXTROSE, SALT, SODIUM BICARBONATE, WHEY POWDER, SOYA LECITHIN, PRESERVATIVES [SODIUM PROPIONATE, POTASSIUM SORBATE], XANTHAN GUM, NATURAL FLAVOUR, DRIED ALBUMEN [EGG WHITES, YEAST, PRESERVATIVE (CITRIC ACID)]. CINNAMON COATING: DEXTROSE, CORN STARCH, PALM OIL SHORTENING, TITANIUM DIOXIDE, CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF: CINNAMON GROUND, PRESERVATIVES [CALCIUM PROPIONATE, POTASSIUM SORBATE], NATURAL FLAVOUR. COCONUT CRUNCH: BREAD CRUMBS, COCONUT, SUGAR, BROWN SUGAR, DEXTROSE, SALT. GLAZE: ICING SUGAR [SUGAR, CORN STARCH], WATER, SUGAR, PALM OIL SHORTENING, MALTODEXTRIN, CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF: ICING BASE [CALCIUM CARBONATE, SUGAR, AGAR, SALT, MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES, SORBITAN MONOSTEARATE], NATURAL FLAVOUR, PRESERVATIVE [POTASSIUM SORBATE].)

2,000 calories a day is used for general nutrition advice, but calorie needs vary. Additional nutrition information available upon request. Since we operate a commercial kitchen where ingredient substitutions, recipe revisions and cross-contact with allergens is possible, we cannot guarantee that any food item will be completely free of allergens. If you need assistance navigating the menu options available due to allergens or intolerances, please speak with the dietitian, chef, or food service manager on duty. Consumer Advisory: *Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness. *A message from the N.C.
